title: ‘You’re coming in blind?’ Chilling audio before medical jet carrying 6 vanished over Atlantic
content: A medical evacuation jet traveling from Bermuda to Boston has gone missing over the Atlantic Ocean. The Gulfstream G100 signaled an emergency and lost contact just moments before it vanished from radar. The US Coast Guard's search efforts have located a debris field south of Nantucket, providing critical details about the situation.

title: 'Rahul was scared to fight from Amethi in LS polls' remark by SP draws Cong's ire
content: "Had there been no alliance (with the Samajwadi Party), they (Congress) wouldn't have won a single seat. It even reached a point where their top leader Rahul Gandhi was ready to give up his seat. He contested from elsewhere (Raebareli) instead of Amethi. He was so scared," SP MP Shiv Pal Singh Patel said.

title: Watch: SP press meet turns violent as ex-district chief slapped over seating
content: A chaotic scene unfolded at a Samajwadi Party press conference in Gorakhpur when a physical clash erupted. It was reported that aspiring candidate Kamlesh Singh slapped former district president Nagina Sahni, following a seating disagreement amidst a packed venue. The atmosphere grew tense, prompting intervention from senior leaders who sought to diffuse the altercation.

title: India’s Asian Games medal map changed: 20 Hangzhou golds gone, 13 new routes to gold
content: India defended only eight of its 28 Hangzhou golds at Aichi-Nagoya, with 20 titles changing hands. All seven shooting golds and all six athletics titles were lost, but the gold medals were replaced from a wider pool. Thirteen came from events where India had won silver or bronze, or had not reached the podium. From Pranavi Urs to Lovlina Borgohain, the medal map changed even as traditional strengths remained again.

title: Bridges under attack: Why Russia is targeting Kyiv's vital crossings
content: In a strategic move, Russia has targeted crucial bridges spanning the Dnipro River in Kyiv, severely impacting transportation and essential infrastructure. The attacks have led to significant traffic congestion throughout the city, with public transport facing notable disruptions. The Southern Bridge has experienced considerable damage, hindering metro services crucial for daily commuters. In light of these assaults, Ukrainian authorities are exploring alternative options to ensure vital crossings remain operational.

title: OpenAI fires researchers, company confirms sacking; shares what investigations revealed
content: OpenAI dismissed three researchers from its safety team after they violated company policies regarding sensitive information. The terminated employees allegedly shared confidential data with external AI safety organizations, prompting an internal investigation. This action is part of OpenAI's response to recent security incidents involving its AI models. The firings coincide with increasing pressure on AI labs to improve safety measures and transparency.

title: ‘Protecting a monster’: CJP sets noon deadline for FIR against Delhi ACP
content: Cockroach Janta Party spokesperson Saurav Das urged Delhi Police to register an FIR against ACP Vivek Bhagat. The demands followed allegations of sexual assault against an independent journalist during protests. Protesters have gathered outside the police station, insisting on action from the police.

title: Battered, stripped, dumped: 21-year-old finance student found dead in Ahmedabad
content: Jigar Solanki, a 21-year-old finance student, left his home on a motorcycle to meet a friend. Hours later, he was discovered injured and stripped in an apartment compound. Despite being rushed to the hospital, he died shortly after arrival due to multiple injuries. Police have initiated a murder investigation against unidentified assailants and are examining CCTV footage.

title: Shubman Gill equals MS Dhoni, Yuvraj Singh to enter elite India club
content: Shubman Gill has successfully equaled the impressive record of MS Dhoni, achieving seven Player of the Series awards in ODIs. This remarkable feat was accomplished following India's recent series victory against the West Indies, where Gill scored 110 runs and an incredible unbeaten 233 in the first two matches. Despite a loss in the third match, his consistent performance places him among legends like Yuvraj Singh and Sourav Ganguly.

title: Napoleon's 1809 code baffled for 217 years, AI cracked it in 6 hours
content: Carter Church, a skilled AI engineer, has managed to crack an elusive military message from 1809, originally ordered by Napoleon. The document remained indecipherable for 217 years because the cypher key was lost. By merging AI technology with historical inquiry, Church unveiled details about troop placements before the Austrian conflict.

title: Carole King's 128-acre Idaho ranch, home for 35 years, sells for $3.99M
content: Carole King purchased Robinson Bar Ranch in Idaho in 1981 and worked on restoring the property for decades. The property, which spans 128 acres, includes various structures and natural features. After significant renovations, the ranch was listed several times before selling for $3.99 million. Its history includes being a mining claim and a resort under previous owners. The ranch exemplifies King's connection to a unique lifestyle away from urban centers.

title: MacKenzie Scott gave $30M to housing nonprofit; a year later, it unveiled 10-year plan
content: MacKenzie Scott has made headlines with her unprecedented $30 million donation to Housing Trust Silicon Valley, marking the organization's largest-ever gift. This investment is set to bolster affordable housing options throughout the Bay Area, as the trust plans to enhance its loan fund and expand various housing initiatives over the next decade.

title: 117-year-old woman's cells shocked scientists: Biologically much younger
content: Scientists investigated María Branyas Morera, the world's oldest verified living person, after her 117th birthday. They collected various biological samples, revealing a mixture of extreme old age signs and youthful features. Despite her short telomeres, she showed less chronic inflammation and a healthy metabolic profile. Her gut microbiome resembled that of younger individuals, raising many fascinating questions.

title: Muslim youths set up BJP office after CM Suvendu Adhikari's ‘friendship’ appeal
content: In a surprising show of political engagement, youths from Sarberia's Muslim community set up a temporary office for the BJP, responding to CM Suvendu Adhikari's encouragement. This initiative aims to bolster support for candidate Hasirani Rath ahead of the looming Oct 6 bypolls. Adhikari stressed the necessity of alliances with minority voters and initiated aspirations for development.

title: Lockheed Martin eyes bigger India footprint with $10.5bn military aircraft bid
content: Lockheed Martin plans to enhance its manufacturing capabilities in India if selected for the medium transport aircraft contract. The company already collaborates with Tata Advanced Systems for C-130J component production in India. The Indian Air Force seeks 60 medium transport aircraft to modernize its fleet due to aging aircraft. Competitors in this bid include Tata, Mahindra, and Adani Defence, partnering with global manufacturers.

title: ‘Great man MS Dhoni’: Hope reveals advice that helped him script record chase
content: Shai Hope played a pivotal role in West Indies' remarkable success against India by scoring an unbeaten 162. His innings helped the team chase down a daunting target of 352 runs with ten balls to spare. After India's innings, bolstered by KL Rahul’s 129, Hope drew inspiration from MS Dhoni to pace his batting.

title: 'Divorce, Rs 30 lakh hospital bill': What led to techie's fatal jump from Supernova
content: Sambhav Jain, a 28-year-old software engineer, died by suicide after jumping from a 41st-floor balcony. He had been staying alone in an Airbnb and expressed feelings of depression before the incident. Police are investigating personal difficulties and financial issues stemming from a recent divorce and medical expenses. Jain's father had suggested he return home to resolve a monetary dispute. The authorities are examining evidence, including CCTV footage and WhatsApp messages.

title: A fossil called Lizzie was thought to be an early reptile
content: A Scottish fossil known as Lizzie was previously considered one of the earliest reptiles. Recent X-ray scans revealed features suggesting it was more fish-like than reptilian. These findings indicate that traits associated with land adaptation developed gradually in tetrapods. Researchers now propose that clawed footprints may have belonged to amphibious relatives instead of early amniotes. This evolution redefines our understanding of early life forms transitioning from water to land.

title: UP woman consumes poison after police 'harassment' over son's elopement with teen
content: A 45-year-old woman consumed poison and died after her family was assaulted by the girl's relatives. Her husband reported harassment by the local police outpost and inappropriate behavior by the officer in charge. They had been threatened while trying to seek help regarding their son, who had eloped with the minor. Protests erupted after her death, demanding accountability for the police’s conduct and actions.

title: China slams US panel’s ‘genocide’ claim after Starbucks opens first Xinjiang stores
content: China's foreign ministry has condemned a US congressional committee's criticism of Starbucks for opening stores in Xinjiang. The US claims genocide against the Uyghur minority in the region, which China denies vehemently. Despite the accusations, Starbucks intends to continue its business operations in Xinjiang. The company recently expanded through a joint venture in China, increasing its nationwide presence.

title: Honeytrapped Indian Navy sailor arrested for leaking key data to Pakistani agent
content: A sailor from the Indian Navy was detained in Coimbatore after being tricked into disclosing defense secrets to a female Pakistani operative. Approached through social media, he ultimately exposed sensitive information regarding naval operations. Digital surveillance confirmed his links before his arrest at INS Agrani. Authorities have obtained a transit warrant to conduct deeper questioning while they assess the gravity of the leaked information and any financial exchanges involved.

title: BCom student stabbed to death in B'luru: How 'feud' over senior girl turned fatal
content: A 19-year-old BCom student named Yogesh was fatally stabbed in Nagarabhavi following a classmate's dispute. The confrontation stemmed from disparaging remarks made by Yogesh regarding a senior girl pursued by Bhuvan. After gathering a group, Bhuvan called Yogesh behind the college to confront him over these remarks. During the violent altercation, one assailant used a knife to stab Yogesh in the chest, ultimately leading to his death.

title: Neeru Dhanda eyes Olympic medal to end wait since Rajyavardhan’s 2004 silver
content: After battling viral fever and a rushed recovery, Neeru Dhanda arrived at the Asian Games 2026 with a dream of winning a medal. She left Aichi-Nagoya with three medals - two golds and a silver - and her sights now firmly set on the Los Angeles Olympics. With the World Championship in Doha her immediate target, Neeru wants to win an Olympic medal and end India’s long wait for a shotgun medal.

title: 2 Keralam nurses among 5 killed in Saudi road accident
content: In a heartbreaking incident, Jaicymol Mathew and Jobina Johny, nurses from Kottayam, perished in a car accident in Saudi Arabia. The fatal crash occurred while they were shopping with two Tamil Nadu colleagues, leading to the vehicle overturning near Rania. All five occupants of the car died instantly. Authorities are now working on the repatriation of their remains back to Kerala.

title: 'Nihangs objected to clothing': Mystery surrounds LGBTQ+ influencer's killing
content: Mad Sandhu, a well-known LGBTQ+ influencer and make-up artist, was shot dead in Amritsar. He was attacked while collecting his car after a wash on Loharka Road. Police have indicated they possess solid leads to identify the attackers and were investigating various angles for a motive. Previously, Sandhu faced objections from a Nihang group regarding his social media content and fashion choices.

title: Drishyam 3 box office day 2: Ajay Devgn thriller races past Rs 100cr
content: Ajay Devgn's Drishyam 3 – The Conclusion earned Rs 53.50 crore on Saturday, down 13.7% from Friday, per Sacnilk. The Abhishek Pathak thriller crossed Rs 100 crore in two days, with Rs 115.50 crore in India and Rs 177.10 crore worldwide. It is expected to pass Rs 150 crore by Sunday.

title: Sam Altman criticises Anthropic’s push to explore AI consciousness and religion
content: I am very uncomfortable about people trying to ascribe religious force or a surrender of human judgment to AI models, and think it is a real safety issue," Altman said in a post to X. The comments were widely seen as a criticism of Anthropic and its co-founder Dario Amodei, who previously worked with Altman at OpenAI.

title: Travis Kelce's $35K donation draws attention amid foundation scrutiny
content: Earlier this year, Travis Kelce won the Walter Payton NFL Man of the Year Charity Challenge for the third time, earning a $35,000 donation. He directed the money to Kansas City nonprofit Operation Breakthrough instead of his own Eighty-Seven and Running Foundation. The decision came amid scrutiny of his charity’s spending, tax filings and governance. Kelce’s business manager said reporting errors are being corrected and the foundation is strengthening its oversight.

title: Clay Matthews' shocking transformation fools NFL fans, but there's a catch
content: The internet was abuzz with images of Clay Matthews that hinted at drastic body transformations, sparking rampant speculation. It was later revealed that these shocking pictures were simply AI-generated hype for promotional purposes. In reality, Matthews hasn’t changed his appearance and still resembles his familiar self in recent events. This incident underscores the ease with which AI can fabricate misleading impressions and influence perceptions.

title: 'My goal is to have 3': Alex Albon wants Thailand to join his list of F1 home races
content: Alex Albon considers Singapore and Malaysia his two Formula 1 home races, but the Williams driver wants Thailand to join that list. With Thailand targeting a potential F1 race in Bangkok from 2028, Albon’s Thai heritage could give him a third home event. Speaking to the Times of India ahead of the Bahrain Grand Prix at Sepang, Albon also discussed his growing role in developing Williams’ future cars and the value of driver experience.

title: Yemeni govt strikes Houthis as tensions rise amid reports of planned Saudi offensive
content: Yemen's government has launched military strikes aimed at Houthi positions in Sanaa, marking a significant escalation amid the Houthis' recent announcement of a naval blockade against Saudi Arabia. As tensions rise, reports indicate that Saudi Arabia could unleash a major offensive against Houthi forces along the Red Sea coast, potentially mobilizing over 100,000 Yemeni troops depending on the operation's scale.

title: Salman Khan reveals ‘10 Ka Dum’ helped him overcome his ‘Negative’ image
content: Salman Khan shared how he faced negativity surrounding his personal life and career after Maine Pyar Kiya. Upon being offered Dus Ka Dum, he was initially hesitant due to the ongoing negativity. His father advised him to be himself, which changed people's perceptions. Viewers began to connect with him as a person rather than just an actor.

title: 'Doing things for social media': Ex-Pak player slams Ayub for Sooryavanshi send-off

Former Pakistan player Kamran Akmal criticised the gesture, saying players should focus on performances rather than social media attention. India posted 211/6, while Hasan Nawaz’s 96 couldn’t prevent Pakistan’s defeat.

title: Apple removes Bitchat app from India App Store after govt order
content: In a significant move, Apple has removed the decentralised messaging app Bitchat from its India App Store. This action follows a directive issued by the Ministry of Electronics and Information Technology, citing illegal content linked to the app. Bitchat, known for its Bluetooth-based mesh networking that allows offline communication, had previously been removed in July before returning to the store. As it stands, Indian users can no longer download Bitchat.

title: Plague in Siberia: Lab worker dies after test-tube accident; 200 contacts monitored

Nearly 200 individuals potentially exposed to her are undergoing medical monitoring. Hospital reports revealed she exhibited severe pneumonia-like symptoms prior to her death. Fortunately, all assessed contacts have tested negative for the plague, alleviating some concern among health officials.

content: the remarks assume significance amid global economic uncertainties . the remarks are triggered by US tariffs and conflicts in Ukraine and west Asia . u.s. finance minister says national security requires structural autonomy in strategic inputs as strategic resource security sits at the centre of macroeconomic policy .

title: ‘Crushing democracy in their DNA’: Shivraj on Congress demanding return to ballot papers
content: Shivraj Singh Chouhan accuses the party of disrespecting the public mandate . he says that while the Congress accepts the Election Commission when it wins elections, it questions the poll body when it loses . the union minister also criticises Congress leaders for demanding a return to ballot-paper voting .

title: Tennessee prison chief Frank Strada resigns after Christa Pike's botched execution
content: governor bill Lee appointed former US Attorney Ed Stanton to lead an independent review of what went wrong during Pike's execution attempt on Wednesday . the governor has halted further executions while the review is under way . he said his resignation was 'in the best interest of Tennesseans' while review is conducted .

title: 'We don’t do background checks on foreign pilots': Israeli minister on flydubai incident
content: the ministry's security division said it does not receive the names of pilots and crew in advance and does not have the ability to conduct background checks on foreign pilots flying into the country . the statement came after multiple reports that pilots from hostile states have repeatedly flown planes into Israel despite regulations intended to prevent them from doing so .

title: Netanyahu invites PM Modi, pilot Machchhar to Israel I-Day
content: prime minister calls pilot a "hero of the entire world" he spoke to the pilot while undergoing treatment at a hospital in the UAE . the 38-year-old pilot recounts how he was attacked by his co-pilot inside the cockpit .

title: ‘Pak buying China’s 5th-gen jets, training its pilots cause for worry’: IAF chief
content: the delay in the induction of fighter jets is 'hurting us as our (squadron) numbers have gone down especially after the phase-out of MiG-21s . the IAF chief made it clear that 'we have less numbers, but we are not weak'

title: Hormuz blocked, but Gulf crude shipments at pre-war level
content: at least 16.5 million barrels per day (mbd) of crude left the region between Sept 1 and 28 matching the prewar average . 83% of the region’s crude crossed Hormuz before the war, 40% was exported in Sept through pipelines in Saudi Arabia and the UAE without crossing the key chokepoint .
